warmup.description: Prepare hips, hamstrings, and glutes with dynamic mobility and unilateral activation.
movements: World’s greatest stretch x 5 each side
Single-leg glute bridges x 10 each side
Ankle rocks (knee over toe) x 10 each side

main_exercises.name: Front Foot Elevated Split Squat
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a moderate load that challenges balance and leaves 2 reps in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep torso upright and allow front knee to travel forward under control

main_exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose a weight that allows controlled balance and a deep hamstring stretch
main_exercises.form_cue: Hinge at the hips and keep hips square to the floor

main_exercises.name: Leg Press (Feet High on Platform)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load at 7/10 effort, stopping before full fatigue
main_exercises.form_cue: Drive through heels and avoid locking out knees aggressively

main_exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a moderate weight that allows explosive but controlled hip drive
main_exercises.form_cue: Snap hips forward and let arms stay relaxed

main_exercises.name: Seated or Lying Hamstring Curl
main_exercises.load_guidance: Select a load that creates tension without losing control at the end range
main_exercises.form_cue: Control both the curl and the extension phases

cooldown.description: Restore mobility and reduce tension in hips and posterior chain.
movements: Calf stretch against wall x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: Unilateral and controlled movements in this session can feel supportive—reduce load if needed and focus on balance and steady tempo. Take extra rest if energy fluctuates.
phase_notes.follicular: Great time to challenge stability and coordination—push slightly heavier loads in split squats and RDLs. You may feel more capable in balance-demanding exercises.
phase_notes.ovulatory: You can perform these movements with strong control and confidence—focus on precision and power in swings and leg press. Maintain good alignment to avoid joint strain.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain consistent effort and use this session to reinforce good movement patterns. Focus on smooth tempo and avoid rushing through unilateral work.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Balance-heavy exercises may feel more demanding—reduce load or reps if needed and prioritize control. This session works well if you keep intensity moderate and manageable.
